events.what: Li, Xiao and Zuo extend the Nakai conjecture to local domains and verify it for isolated hypersurface singularities of modality ≤ 2

judgement.doubts: The case/variant call is the only real question. The local-domain formulation has the same hypothesis and conclusion and is a strengthening, so its truth for the local rings of modality ≤ 2 isolated hypersurface singularities should cover varieties whose singular points are all of that type; that makes it a restriction (case), not a changed question. But the researcher never read the full text, so the exact implication back to the finite-type statement was not confirmed. The absence of AI is inferred from the abstract and secondary summaries only. The Zariski–Lipman formal-conjectures issue is correctly excluded.

corrections.why: other: kept as partial. The competing_reading argues the local-domain extension may be a variant, but the paper verifies a strengthened form of the same statement (same hypothesis, same regularity conclusion) on a restricted class of singularities, which is a case of the bullet. The record did not confirm this from the full text, so there is residual doubt.
